whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text: Hi, I'm Hannah. And I'm Sai. Welcome to the Holographic Studios. We are an iconic art institution that's been here since the 1970s. Over the past 43 years, we have introduced over 10,000 people to holography, as well as being the only and oldest free gallery and teaching center for holography. We also have an internship that mentors young artists and has produced an Emmy winner, an Oscar winner, and a Grammy winner. We really need your help to sustain our business because the pandemic has hit us hard. This place means the world to us and everybody who loves holograms. Help us save Holographic Studios! Thank you!
